query.postgres: insert into {0} (entityid, versions, processed) select entityid, string_agg(versionnumber::varchar, '{1}' order by versionnumber) as versions, false from (select distinct entityid, versionnumber from sungero_content_dochistory where action in ('create', 'update') and (operation in ('createversion', 'updateverbody', 'import') or operation is null) and versionnumber is not null and '{2}'::timestamp < historydate and historydate < '{3}'::timestamp order by entityid, versionnumber) as versions_table group by entityid order by entityid
